相對地，微軟(MSFT-US) 與 SpaceX 則打破低迷氣氛，其財報顯示 AI 投資已開始展現成效。
摩根資產管理（JPMorgan Asset Management）全球多重資產戰略研究主管 John Bilton 表示，市場可能過高估計了成長強度，但整體並未陷入負成長，大眾對數據的需求依然強勁且持續成長。
舉債規模持續攀升
微軟計劃透過逾九年來首度在美國發行投資等級債券，籌資約250億美元。其他超大規模雲端業者方面，Meta、亞馬遜與Alphabet過去四年已累計發債數千億美元，令投資人擔憂這些公司過度依賴債券籌資。
摩根士丹利預估，明年整體AI基礎設施資本支出將突破1兆美元。
AI企業對債務融資的依賴度增加，已轉變為投資人的新風險，並打破了這群處於 AI 浪潮核心的公司能免疫於總體經濟壓力的觀念。
這股疑慮正從股市蔓延至信用市場。投資人開始將一種可能性反映在價格中：融資成本上升，加上AI支出回報速度放緩，可能壓縮這些原本被視為較能抵禦外部衝擊的企業。
營收表現依然穩健
自 ChatGPT 於 2022 年推出以來，「科技七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）的整體營收始終維持強勁，展現出極具韌性的需求，這或許解釋了為何即使回報時程尚不確定，投資人最初仍願意支持這些鉅額支出。
亞馬遜的獲利金雞母 AWS 雲端服務持續加速成長；Meta 則繳出優於預期的營收成長與樂觀展望；微軟也在最新財報中預測雲端業務將強勁成長。
資本支出衝上驚人規模
大型科技公司過去就經常斥巨資建置基礎設施，以建立並擴展雲端運算、網路廣告與電子商務等業務，但AI熱潮已將資本支出推升至驚人水準。
摩根大通預估，到2030年，全球AI資本支出將達5.5兆美元，光是2026年就將投入9,000億美元。
摩根大通分析師指出，亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta、甲骨文與微軟今年的AI資本支出，可能相當於這些公司自2022年11月ChatGPT推出以來的累計支出。
paras_en: The Nasdaq-100 index, which is heavily weighted toward tech stocks, could see its market value shrink by more than $2 trillion this month. After big‑tech earnings were released, investors are focusing even more on whether the massive AI spending by these firms can generate returns quickly enough.
The loss in market value would be slightly larger than SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) total market cap. With AI trading under pressure, the Nasdaq‑100 has fallen more than 5.8% since the start of October.
Mega‑cloud providers such as Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) have successively raised their capital‑expenditure forecasts to speed up the build‑out of AI infrastructure.
The prospect of ever‑growing AI investment is unsettling for investors, especially as borrowing costs rise; raising money through debt is becoming more expensive and harder to justify.

With Apple (AAPL‑US) slated to report earnings next week and AI‑driven Nvidia (NVDA‑US) set to take the stage in mid‑November, the market is closely watching the profit performance of the tech giants.
Tech stocks get hammered
Alphabet posted its biggest one‑day drop in history on Thursday (the 29th) after its core search‑advertising business underperformed and cash burn accelerated sharply.

Meta’s plan to raise a record $97.5 billion has heightened concerns about equity dilution and raised worries that massive AI spending could force other tech giants to turn to the capital markets for funding as well.
By contrast, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and SpaceX broke the gloom, with their earnings showing that AI investments are beginning to pay off.

John Bilton, head of global multi‑asset strategy research at JPMorgan Asset Management, said the market may have over‑estimated growth intensity, but the sector is not in negative growth; demand for data remains strong and continues to rise.
Debt issuance keeps climbing

Microsoft plans to issue investment‑grade bonds in the United States for the first time in more than nine years, raising about $25 billion. Other ultra‑large cloud players—Meta, Amazon and Alphabet—have issued tens of billions of dollars in debt over the past four years, prompting worries that they are becoming overly reliant on bond financing.
Morgan Stanley projects that total AI‑infrastructure capital spending will exceed $1 trillion next year.
The growing reliance of AI firms on debt financing has become a new risk for investors and shatters the notion that companies at the heart of the AI wave are immune to broader economic pressures.

That concern is spilling over from the equity market into the credit market. Investors are beginning to price in the possibility that higher financing costs combined with slower AI‑spending payback could compress the earnings of firms once thought to be more resilient to external shocks.
Revenue performance remains solid

Since ChatGPT’s launch in 2022, the “Magnificent Seven” tech giants have consistently posted strong overall revenue, showing remarkably resilient demand—perhaps explaining why investors initially backed massive spending even though the payoff timeline is still uncertain.

Amazon’s profit‑driving AWS cloud service continues to accelerate; Meta delivered better‑than‑expected revenue growth and an upbeat outlook; and Microsoft forecast strong growth for its cloud business in its latest earnings report.
Capital spending has surged to astonishing levels

Large tech firms have long spent heavily on building infrastructure to expand cloud computing, online advertising and e‑commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditures to eye‑popping heights.
JPMorgan estimates that global AI capital spending will reach $5.5 trillion by 2030, with $900 billion slated for 2026 alone.

JPMorgan analysts note that this year’s AI capital spending by Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and Microsoft could equal the cumulative AI spend these companies have made since ChatGPT’s debut in November 2022.

items.title: 英特爾盤中崩跌30%！恐寫史上最慘一天 全球晶片股跟著殺
items.title_en: Intel Plummets 30% Intraday! Potentially the Worst Day in History, Global Chip Stocks Follow Suit
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)周五(30日)盤中重挫30%，恐創歷來最大單日跌幅，市值可能蒸發逾1,460億美元，並引發全球晶片股賣壓。PC需求疲弱、記憶體漲價及AI建設成本攀升，使投資人重新檢視科技業的獲利與現金流前景。
根據《路透》報導，英特爾預估單季營收較市場預期低逾10億美元，並警告今年現金流無法轉正。此前，臉書母公司Meta(META-US)、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)財報已凸顯AI支出與舉債壓力；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)則公布龐大現金流出，並預告明年資本支出將進一步增加。

股債同步承壓 賣壓擴散全球

美國政府去年8月取得英特爾10%股權，成為最大股東，此次跌勢恐使其持股價值縮水近120億美元。信用市場也響起警訊，英特爾五年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差擴大17.5個基點至124.75個基點，創歷史新高，單日升幅可能為2022年10月以來最大。
不過，美國政府與輝達(NVDA-US)的投資已強化英特爾財務。截至9月底，公司持有現金及約當現金218.4億美元，長期債務則為463.2億美元。
超微(AMD-US)、安謀(ARM-US)、高通(QCOM-US)、輝達、博通(AVGO-US)及美光(MU-US)下跌4%至12%。艾司摩爾(ASML-US)(ASML-NL)歐股跌逾6%，台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)台股跌近2%；戴爾(DELL-US)、慧與科技(HPE-US)及美超微(SMCI-US)則跌6%至11%。

PC成本攀升 產能配置遭質疑

這波重挫前，英特爾今年股價已翻倍，去年也大漲逾80%。AI代理與聊天機器人推升中央處理器需求，加上晶圓代工布局取得進展，讓英特爾重新成為AI熱潮受惠者。
然而，擴建製造業務消耗大量現金，供應中斷又限制公司滿足資料中心晶片需求。占第三季營收約一半的PC晶片業務，也因記憶體供應商轉向AI使用的高頻寬記憶體，導致傳統記憶體漲價而承壓。
Seaport Research Partners分析師Jay Goldberg認為，賣壓反映市場對管理層失去信任。他批評，英特爾在15年來最差的PC市場生產過多消費型晶片，卻在半導體最強成長週期中，未能供應足夠AI伺服器晶片，問題出在規畫不當。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) on Friday (the 30th) saw its stock tumble 30% mid‑session, potentially marking the largest single‑day drop ever, wiping out over $146 billion in market value and sparking sell‑offs across global chip stocks. Weak PC demand, rising memory prices and soaring AI‑building costs have prompted investors to re‑examine tech earnings and cash‑flow outlooks.

According to Reuters, Intel forecasts quarterly revenue more than $1 billion below market expectations and warned that cash flow will not turn positive this year. Earlier, Meta (META-US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) had already highlighted AI spending and debt pressures in their earnings, with Amazon reporting massive cash outflows and flagging higher capital expenditures next year.

Equity and debt are under pressure as the sell‑off spreads globally. The U.S. government, which acquired a 10% stake in Intel last August becoming its largest shareholder, could see the value of its holding shrink by nearly $12 billion. In the credit market, Intel’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread widened 17.5 basis points to 124.75 bps, a historic high and the biggest one‑day jump since October 2022.

However, investments from the U.S. government and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) have bolstered Intel’s finances. As of the end of September, the company held $21.84 billion in cash and cash equivalents, with long‑term debt of $46.32 billion.

AMD (AMD‑US), Arm (ARM‑US), Qualcomm (QCOM‑US), Nvidia, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) fell between 4% and 12%. ASML (ASML‑US/ASML‑NL) slid more than 6% in European markets, TSMC (2330‑TW/TSM‑US) dropped nearly 2% on the Taiwan exchange, while Dell (DELL‑US), HPE (HPE‑US) and Super Micro (SMCI‑US) fell 6% to 11%.

Before this plunge, Intel’s share price had doubled this year and surged over 80% last year. AI agents and chatbots have boosted demand for central processing units, and progress in foundry partnerships has positioned Intel as a beneficiary of the AI boom.

Nevertheless, expanding manufacturing consumes massive cash, and supply disruptions limit the company’s ability to meet data‑center chip demand. The PC chip segment, which accounts for about half of third‑quarter revenue, is also under pressure as memory suppliers shift to high‑bandwidth memory for AI, driving up traditional memory prices.

Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg said the sell‑off reflects a loss of market confidence in management. He criticized Intel for overproducing consumer chips in the weakest PC market in 15 years while failing to supply enough AI server chips during the semiconductor industry’s strongest growth cycle, attributing the issue to poor planning.

items.title: 通膨不會自己降！穆薩列姆籲Fed儘快再升息 市場估12月升息機率近八成
items.title_en: Inflation Won't Drop on Its Own! Musalem Urges the Fed to Raise Rates Again Soon, Market Estimates December Rate Hike Probability Near 80%
paras: 聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)周五(30日)表示，美國通膨仍過高，聯準會(Fed)有必要「儘快」進一步升息。他主張，趁通膨預期仍穩定時及早小幅調整政策，比日後被迫大幅緊縮，更有機會避免傷及就業與經濟成長。
根據外媒報導，穆薩列姆在為影子公開市場委員會活動準備的講稿中指出，通膨持續高於2%目標，且仍有上行風險。若Fed不調整政策，物價漲幅可能長期維持在目標之上。
Fed本周將基準利率維持在3.75%至4.00%，但有兩名官員主張升息而投下反對票。穆薩列姆今年沒有政策投票權，他的發言進一步強化市場對12月恢復升息的預期。芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，利率期貨交易員當時估計，12月升息1碼的機率約為76%。
穆薩列姆認為，儘管金融情勢近期收緊，貨幣政策與整體金融環境仍偏寬鬆，目前不足以有效壓低通膨。他強調，及早採取漸進調整，通常比延後才突然大幅行動造成的干擾更小。
談及經濟，他形容美國仍具韌性，並援引周四公布、優於預期的3.4%國內生產毛額(GDP)成長率。AI基礎建設投資及寬鬆金融環境，都是支撐經濟的因素。
他也認為，勞動市場相當穩定且供需平衡，4.2%的失業率與Fed官員長期預測中位數一致。不過，最新個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率仍超過3%，顯示物價穩定目標尚未達成。
穆薩列姆表示，貨幣政策現在對就業與經濟成長最有利的做法，就是及時恢復物價穩定；在通膨根深柢固、民眾預期漲價將持續之前行動，降低通膨的短期經濟代價會比較小。
Fed主席華許本周則肯定抑制通膨的進展，但承認尚未實現物價穩定，並未透露對12月8日至9日會議利率決策的看法。
paras_en: St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank President Alberto Musalem said on Friday (the 30th) that U.S. inflation remains too high and the Fed needs to "as soon as possible" raise rates further. He argues that making a modest policy adjustment early while inflation expectations are still anchored offers a better chance of avoiding damage to jobs and economic growth than being forced into a large tightening later.

According to foreign media reports, Musalem noted in a speech prepared for a shadow open market committee event that inflation continues to run above the 2% target and still carries upside risks. If the Fed does not adjust policy, price gains could remain above the target for an extended period.

The Fed will keep its policy rate in the 3.75%‑4.00% range this week, but two officials voted for a hike and cast dissenting votes. Musalem does not have a voting right on policy this year, yet his comments further reinforced market expectations of a December rate increase. The CME FedWatch tool showed that futures traders then estimated about a 76% chance of a 0.25‑point hike in December.

Musalem believes that despite recent financial tightening, monetary policy and the overall financial environment are still relatively accommodative and not sufficient to bring inflation down effectively. He stresses that an early, gradual adjustment usually causes less disruption than a delayed, sudden large‑scale move.

On the economy, he described the United States as still resilient and cited Thursday’s better‑than‑expected 3.4% GDP growth rate. AI infrastructure investment and the accommodative financial setting are among the factors supporting growth.

He also said the labor market remains fairly stable and balanced, with the 4.2% unemployment rate matching the median long‑term forecast of Fed officials. However, the latest personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index annual growth still exceeds 3%, indicating the price‑stability goal has not yet been met.

Musalem stated that the most employment‑ and growth‑friendly monetary policy action now is to promptly restore price stability; acting before inflation becomes entrenched and public expectations of rising prices persist will lower the short‑term economic cost of bringing inflation down.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell this week affirmed progress in curbing inflation but acknowledged that price stability has not yet been achieved, and he did not disclose his view on the rate decision for the Dec. 8‑9 meeting.

items.title: 高盛押注AI反彈換打法：不直接做多、先買好「保險」
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Bets on AI Rally with a New Play: No Direct Long, First Buy "Insurance"
paras: 高盛(GS-US) 調整人工智慧（AI）交易策略，建議投資人透過選擇權「租用」反彈的上漲空間，並搭配賣權作為下跌保險。即使獲利支撐與偏低部位可能推升年底行情，AI前景、中東局勢及美國期中選舉的不確定性，仍讓高盛傾向以限制損失的方式參與反彈。
這項布局反映市場對AI交易的分歧。大型科技股選擇權的定價，彷彿恐慌已經過去；新興雲端業者的股債表現，卻顯示壓力仍在升高。高盛希望保留參與年底行情的機會，同時為市場再度下跌預作準備。
波動太劇烈 先替反彈布局買保險
高盛衍生性商品交易台指出，今年以來，其動量因子股票籃子已有30次單日波動超過5%，頻率甚至高於2000年網路泡沫、2008年金融危機及新冠疫情期間。
雖然獲利支撐與處於五年低點的輕倉部位，可能帶動股市年底前走高，但劇烈震盪使直接持股的風險升高。高盛因此建議，透過損失有限的選擇權結構參與潛在軋空行情。
在避險工具上，高盛偏好2027年3月到期、90%的標普500指數回溯型賣權，成本為1.82%。其履約價可隨市場每日走勢向上調整，讓投資人不必精準掌握進場時點，也能取得下檔保護，保留參與年底行情的機會。
科技巨頭選擇權便宜 亞馬遜成布局標的
近期避險基金與做多機構賣出近200億美元科技、媒體及電信類股，規模逼近7月，但大型科技股的選擇權定價卻相對便宜。
高盛數據顯示，科技七巨頭相對整體科技類股的隱含波動率，落在過去四年的第15百分位。
個股方面，高盛看好亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 12月到期、履約價280／310美元的買權價差策略。該股較年內高點回落約10%，但仍守住支撐，近期去槓桿環境也與7月大漲前相似。
微軟(MSFT-US) 選擇權市場隱含的財報後波動幅度則僅4.7%，遠低於上季的15.5%。此外，納斯達克100與標普500指數的隱含波動率價差，在近期急升後大幅回落，顯示市場已賣出大量波動率溢價。
個股齊跌 高盛改做波動率價差
AI概念股下跌時走勢愈來愈一致，也改變了避險需求。高盛結構化產品團隊的Adrien Simonet指出，納斯達克100指數的12個月隱含相關性，已從夏季約25%升至32.6%；個股相對指數的波動率比值，則由2倍以上降至1.8倍。
對此，高盛提出「離散交易」，也就是放空指數波動率、做多個股波動率。策略涵蓋蘋果、輝達等19檔納斯達克成分股，透過變異數交換組合，利用指數波動率風險溢酬，支應做多個股波動率的成本。
新雲端業者壓力大 搶反彈偏好可轉債
相較於科技巨頭，新興雲端服務商的處境更為嚴峻。高盛追蹤的相關股票籃子本月跌逾28%，對想參與反彈的投資人，高盛偏好CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 可轉換公司債，而非直接買進股票。
CoreWeave股價本月下跌30%，其可轉債在Delta中性基礎上僅下跌1至2點。相較一般債券，可轉債提供約300個基點的額外收益，隱含波動率也低於交易所選擇權，並可搭配信用違約交換（CDS）及一般債券避險。
摩根大通(JPM-US) 則指出，貸款機構為對沖資料中心貸款風險而買進CDS，已推升AI相關信用利差。該行警告，新興雲端業者存在破產風險，大型科技公司可能以極低價格收購破產資產。
便宜買權有代價 漲太多也可能歸零
高盛也提供3個月期、105%／130%的連續觸價失效買權，供預期股價溫和上漲的客戶選擇，成本僅為一般買權的一小部分。
但低成本附帶嚴格條件：股價超過初始價格的105%後，投資人可取得一比一的上漲收益；若盤中任何時刻觸及130%，選擇權便立即失效，收益歸零。在動量股頻繁大幅震盪的環境下，便宜並不代表風險低。
反彈能否成真 還有三道關卡
高盛衍生性商品專家Brian Garrett認為，市場可能已走到「大規模去槓桿的第八局」，而非「整個AI生態系重新定價的第二局」。
但要確認觸底，仍需債市波動下降、美國期中選舉不確定性消退，以及AI資本支出反映在企業獲利上。
高盛也看好以韓國ETF(EWY-US) 買權價差參與反彈，認為韓股本月遭大幅減碼後，一旦AI交易回溫，可能引發追漲。
整體而言，高盛目前的布局仍著重短期反彈，透過選擇權限制風險、搭配賣權提供保護，尚非全面押注新一輪牛市。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) has adjusted its artificial intelligence (AI) trading strategy, advising investors to "rent" the upside of a rebound through options while pairing it with puts as downside insurance. Even though profit support and low‑position levels could lift year‑end markets, uncertainties around AI prospects, Middle‑East tensions and the U.S. midterm elections lead Goldman to prefer a loss‑limiting approach to the rally.

This positioning reflects the market’s split view on AI trading. Pricing of options on large‑cap tech stocks suggests panic has faded, yet the equity‑debt performance of emerging cloud players shows pressure is still rising. Goldman wants to keep a foot in the year‑end rally while preparing for another market dip.
Volatility Too Extreme, So Buy Insurance for the Rebound First

Goldman’s derivatives desk noted that since the start of the year its momentum‑factor stock basket has experienced 30 single‑day moves of more than 5%, a frequency higher than during the 2000 dot‑com bubble, the 2008 financial crisis and the COVID‑19 pandemic periods.

Although profit support and a light‑weight position at a five‑year low could push the market higher before year‑end, the sharp swings raise the risk of holding stocks outright. Consequently Goldman recommends participating in any potential short‑covering rally via a limited‑loss options structure.

For hedging, Goldman prefers a March 2027, 90%‑of‑S&P 500 reverse‑recovery put costing 1.82%. Its strike can be adjusted upward each day with market moves, allowing investors to obtain downside protection without pinpointing an exact entry point while preserving upside participation for the year‑end rally.
Tech Giants’ Options Are Cheap, Amazon Becomes a Target

Recently, hedge funds and long‑biased institutions have sold nearly $20 billion of technology, media and telecom stocks, a volume approaching July’s peak, yet options on large‑cap tech remain relatively inexpensive.
Goldman data show that the implied volatility of the seven major tech giants sits at the 15th percentile of the overall tech sector over the past four years.

On the stock level, Goldman favors an Amazon (AMZN-US) call spread expiring in December with strikes at $280/$310. The stock has slipped about 10% from its intra‑year high but still holds support, and the current de‑leveraging environment resembles that before the July surge.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) options imply post‑earnings volatility of only 4.7%, far below last quarter’s 15.5%. Moreover, the implied‑volatility spread between the Nasdaq‑100 and the S&P 500, after a recent sharp rise, has retreated markedly, indicating that the market has sold a large amount of volatility premium.
Stocks Falling Across the Board, Goldman Shifts to Volatility Spreads

When AI‑related stocks decline, their moves become increasingly synchronized, altering hedging demand. Goldman’s structured‑products team member Adrien Simonet notes that the 12‑month implied correlation of the Nasdaq‑100 has risen from roughly 25% in the summer to 32.6%; the ratio of individual‑stock volatility to index volatility has fallen from over 2× to 1.8×.

In response, Goldman proposes a “discrete trade” – shorting index volatility while going long stock volatility. The strategy covers 19 Nasdaq constituents such as Apple and Nvidia, using variance‑swap combinations to fund the long side with the risk premium earned from shorting index volatility.
Emerging Cloud Players Under Pressure, Preference for Convertible Bonds in the Rebound

Compared with the tech giants, emerging cloud service providers face a tougher environment. The basket of related stocks Goldman tracks has dropped more than 28% this month; for investors seeking a rebound, Goldman prefers CoreWeave (CRWV-US) convertible bonds rather than buying the equity outright.

CoreWeave’s share price has fallen 30% this month, while its convertibles have slipped only 1–2 points on a delta‑neutral basis. Compared with plain bonds, the convertibles offer roughly 300 basis points extra yield, lower implied volatility than exchange‑traded options, and can be paired with credit‑default swaps (CDS) and standard bond hedges.

JPMorgan (JPM-US) notes that lenders buying CDS to hedge data‑center loan risk have pushed AI‑related credit spreads higher. The bank warns that emerging cloud firms carry bankruptcy risk, and large tech companies may acquire distressed assets at rock‑bottom prices.
Cheap Calls Come With a Cost – Too Much Rise Can Nullify Them
Goldman also offers a three‑month, 105%/130% sequential knock‑out call for clients expecting modest stock gains, costing only a fraction of a standard call.

However, the low cost carries strict conditions: if the stock exceeds 105% of its initial price, investors receive a 1‑for‑1 upside; but if it ever hits 130% intraday, the option instantly knocks out and the payoff drops to zero. In an environment where momentum stocks swing wildly, cheap does not equal low risk.
Can the Rebound Materialize? Three More Hurdles Remain
Goldman derivatives expert Brian Garrett believes the market may have entered the “eighth round of massive deleveraging” rather than the “second round of a full AI‑ecosystem repricing.”
But confirming a bottom still requires a decline in bond‑market volatility, the fading of U.S. midterm‑election uncertainty, and AI capital spending translating into corporate earnings.
Goldman also likes a call spread on the Korea ETF (EWY-US) to capture a rebound, arguing that after heavy reductions in Korean stocks this month, a warming AI trade could spark a buying surge.
Overall, Goldman’s current layout remains focused on a short‑term rebound, using options to cap risk and puts for protection, rather than a full‑scale bet on a new bull market.

items.title: 科技巨頭AI魔法正在褪色 華爾街年終行情面臨艱難考驗
items.title_en: Tech Giants' AI Magic Fades as Wall Street Faces Tough Year‑End Test
paras: 華爾街原本期待，在人工智慧(AI)投資題材支撐下，科技巨頭財報可以帶動第3季財報預期上修，沒想到本周揭露的業績表現不如預期，這股期待如今開始消退，整體市場也開始顯露疲態，讓今年最後兩個月的行情增添變數。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周四(29日)股價暴跌近13%，創上市以來史上最大單日跌幅，加上科技巨頭同業微軟(MSFT-US)股價小幅下跌，拖累美股大幅走低。
標普500指數(SPX)10月估僅小幅上漲1%，9月下跌0.45%。那斯達克綜合指數(COMP)10月則估跌2.2%。
目前已公布財報的「科技七巨頭」業績令人失望，而接下來幾周即將公布財報的企業，也未能讓市場清楚判斷AI投資的實際成效。這顯示AI題材對市場的影響力正逐漸減弱。
同一時間，市場背景中的重大風險正在累積，包括伊朗戰爭、聯準會(Fed)可能被迫升息，以及美國消費者開始感受到通膨加速與就業不安全感揮之不去的衝擊。這些因素都讓股市在多頭行情邁入第五年之際面臨挑戰。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond說：「AI交易題材不一定已經失靈，但市場關注的焦點正從資本支出，擴大到執行能力與商業化變現。從長期來看，這是比較健康的發展，儘管可能造成更大的波動，也會讓大型科技公司的股價表現出現更明顯的差異。」
Questar Capital Partners投資長Richard Reyle認為，科技股交易已來到轉折點，「這勢必會造就贏家與輸家」。
他表示：「我們現在開始看得出，哪些企業在AI上的支出合理，哪些企業並非如此。科技業財報季傳達的訊息很簡單：資本支出增加，加上大規模發行股票，會引發投資人撤離相關股票。」

科技股財報驚喜不如預期 AI投資開始考驗變現能力

標普500科技類股指數(IXT)過去一個月下跌近3%，較6月初高點回落約4.8%。這使大盤受到打壓，標普500指數過去五個月僅上漲1.4%。
第3季財報季迄今已公布財報企業略高於一半，根據LSEG數據，獲利超越市場預期的幅度平均為4.5%，遠低於第4季平均約7.7%的財報「驚喜」幅度。
LSEG數據顯示，科技類股的財報驚喜幅度為4.7%，包含Alphabet在內的通訊服務類股則為負1.5%。
以企業業績不出色來解釋或許有失公允，科技業這季獲利可能仍占標普500指數整體獲利中約一半，第4季預估也將占相近比重。但科技業已不再像過去那樣，為市場帶來額外的強勁推力，這正是令人擔憂之處。
凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)金融市場首席經濟顧問John Higgins說：「我們的基本情境是，標普500指數獲利從AI革命於2002年11月開始以來就大幅成長的趨勢，到了明年將無法延續。我們懷疑這股成長動能將有一部分遭到逆轉，進而拖累整體表現。」
他說：「考量過去四年來，科技業與整體AI投資題材一直支撐美國市場，這種可能性就令人擔憂。再加上伊朗戰爭造成能源價格動盪，並持續推升通膨壓力，情況就更令人憂心。」

通膨與升息風險升高 油價恐再推升市場壓力

聯準會(Fed)本周成功避開在10月升息，但通膨數據和穩健的預期經濟成長速度，可能讓Fed無法在12月繼續按兵不動。
Plante Moran Financial投資長Jim Baird說：「經濟成長強勁，民間內需更為強勁，裁員人數仍低，通膨則仍居高不下。你還需要看到什麼，才會進一步收緊貨幣政策？」
油價目前已穩居每桶100美元以上。若在11月3日的美國期中選舉結束後，美國與以色列決定對伊朗發動更大規模、破壞力更強的攻擊，油價可能進一步攀升。
這場期中選舉也可能比傳統風險指標目前所顯示的更容易撼動市場。民調顯示，民主黨可能取得顯著進展並重新掌控眾議院，但參議院是否也會由民主黨取得多數，仍有變數。
RBC Capital Markets美股策略主管Lori Calvasina表示：「我們認為，兩黨分掌國會對股市而言屬於中性至小幅正面事件：民主黨全面勝出屬於中性至負面事件，共和黨全面勝出則屬於正面事件。」
她補充說：「不過，重要的是持續關注投票率，以及出口民調所反映的選民投票原因，了解選民為何選擇支持某一方。」

年底衝刺時間有限 標普500挑戰8000點難度升高

這些潛在逆風接連浮現，對過去四年大多依賴科技股支撐的市場而言，是一大考驗。
從現在到年底還有44個交易日，市場仍有許多工作要做。假設標普500指數要達到華爾街堅定預測的8000點，就必須在剩餘交易日平均每天上漲約6.8點。
但今年以來，該指數每日平均漲幅約為4.4點，而在科技股與AI投資題材迅速褪色的情況下，要一個動能已所剩無幾的市場達成這項目標，恐怕有些困難。
paras_en: Wall Street had originally hoped that AI‑driven investment themes would lift tech‑giant earnings and prompt an upward revision of third‑quarter forecasts, but this week’s disappointing results have dampened that optimism, leaving the broader market showing signs of fatigue and adding uncertainty to the final two months of the year.

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) saw its stock plunge nearly 13% on Thursday (the 29th), marking the largest single‑day drop since its listing, and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) also slipped slightly, pulling U.S. equities sharply lower.
The S&P 500 (SPX) is projected to rise only about 1% in October after a 0.45% decline in September, while the Nasdaq Composite (COMP) is expected to fall 2.2% for the month.

The earnings already reported by the “Big Seven” tech companies have been disappointing, and the upcoming reports in the next few weeks do not give the market a clear view of AI’s real impact, indicating that the AI theme’s market influence is waning.

At the same time, major background risks are building up, including the Iran war, a possible forced rate hike by the Fed, and U.S. consumers feeling the sting of accelerating inflation and lingering job‑security concerns, all of which challenge the market as it enters its fifth year of a bull run.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said: “The AI trade theme may not have completely broken down yet, but market focus is shifting from capital spending to execution capability and commercialisation. In the long run that’s a healthier development, even if it brings more volatility and makes the performance of large‑cap tech stocks diverge more sharply.”
Richard Reyle, Chief Investment Officer at Questar Capital Partners, believes tech‑stock trading has reached a turning point, “which will inevitably create winners and losers.”

He added: “We’re now starting to see which companies’ AI spending is justified and which isn’t. The message from this tech earnings season is simple: higher capex combined with large‑scale share issuances will trigger investors to pull out of the affected stocks.”

Tech‑stock earnings fell short of expectations, putting AI’s monetisation to the test. The S&P 500 Information Technology Index (IXT) has dropped nearly 3% over the past month, retreating about 4.8% from its early‑June peak, dragging the broader market down as the S&P 500 has risen only 1.4% over the last five months.

To date, slightly more than half of the companies in the Q3 earnings season have reported, and LSEG data show that earnings beat the market by an average of 4.5%, far below the roughly 7.7% “surprise” average seen in Q4 historically.
LSEG data indicate that the earnings surprise for tech stocks is 4.7%, while communication‑services stocks—including Alphabet—registered a negative 1.5% surprise.

Attributing the weak results solely to company performance may be unfair; tech earnings this quarter likely still account for about half of total S&P 500 earnings, and a similar share is expected in Q4. However, tech is no longer providing the extra thrust it once did, which is concerning.

John Higgins, Chief Economic Adviser for Capital Economics, said: “Our baseline scenario is that the profit growth the S&P 500 has enjoyed since the AI revolution began in November 2002 will not be sustainable next year. We suspect part of that growth engine will reverse, dragging overall performance down.”

He added: “Given that tech and the broader AI theme have been supporting the U.S. market for the past four years, that prospect is worrisome. Add the Iran war‑induced energy price volatility and continued inflation pressure, and the outlook looks even bleaker.”

Inflation and rate‑rise risks are rising, and oil prices could further pressure markets. The Fed managed to avoid a rate hike in October, but inflation data and a solid growth outlook may prevent it from staying on hold through December.

Jim Baird, Chief Investment Officer at Plante Moran Financial, said: “Economic growth is strong, private demand is robust, layoffs remain low, and inflation stays high. What else do you need to see before tightening monetary policy further?”

Oil is currently trading above $100 a barrel. If, after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, the United States and Israel decide to launch a larger, more destructive attack on Iran, oil prices could climb even higher.

The midterms may also prove more market‑shaking than traditional risk gauges suggest. Polls indicate the Democrats could make significant gains and retake the House, but whether they also capture a Senate majority remains uncertain.

Lori Calvasina, Head of U.S. Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, said: “We view a split Congress as a neutral‑to‑slightly‑positive event for equities; a full Democratic sweep as neutral‑to‑negative; and a full Republican sweep as positive.”
She added: “What matters is monitoring voter turnout and the reasons voters give for their choices, as reflected in exit polls, to understand the drivers behind their decisions.”

The limited time left in the year makes the S&P 500’s push toward 8,000 points increasingly difficult. These emerging headwinds pose a major test for a market that has relied heavily on tech stocks for the past four years.

With 44 trading days remaining until year‑end, the market still has work to do. To hit the Wall Street‑forecast 8,000 level, the S&P 500 would need to average about 6.8 points of gain per day for the rest of the year.
So far this year the index has averaged roughly 4.4 points per day, and with tech stocks and AI themes fading rapidly, achieving that target in a market with dwindling momentum looks doubtful.

items.title: 美股亮罕見警訊！關鍵指標飆近70年新高 兩場大熊市曾出現
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Light Rare Warning! Key Indicator Soars to Near 70-Year High After Two Bear Markets
paras: 美股罕見警示燈亮了！衡量優質股與低品質股相對表現的「優質減劣質因子」（QMJ），今年7月大漲14.3%，創1957年以來最大單月漲幅。歷史上，單月漲幅第二、第三大的時點，分別落在2000年11月與2008年10月，正值網路泡沫與金融海嘯熊市期間，如今指標再度飆升，引發市場戒心。
這次警訊出現在低品質股經歷史上最長、最猛烈的領漲行情之後。投資研究機構Porter and Company創辦人F. Porter Stansberry認為，人工智慧（AI）狂熱催生的投機行情已出現轉折，直言「現在是謹慎的時候了」。
低品質股狂飆 AI熱潮推波助瀾
這輪低品質股跑贏優質股的行情，從2023年11月延續至2026年6月，持續時間與幅度均創紀錄。期間，做多美國最高品質企業、做空最低品質企業的投資組合累計虧損36%，是QMJ自1957年有紀錄以來最差的一段表現。
截至2026年5月的12個月，也是69年紀錄中，優質股相對表現最弱的12個月。QMJ在2023年至2025年連續三年虧損，今年前八個月仍下跌3.8%，反映投資人追逐低品質股的力道。
AI熱潮是這波行情的主要推手。根據彭博數據，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子，今年前五個月大漲57%，遠超標普500指數同期的11%。成分企業逾四分之一虧損的羅素2000小型股指數，上半年也上漲22.7%，漲幅超過大盤兩倍。
Stansberry將這波行情稱為「科技驅動的垃圾股泡沫」，並指出，其規模已是有紀錄以來最大。
警示指標看什麼？獲利、成長與安全
QMJ由AQR資本管理公司創辦人Cliff Asness與同事Andrea Frazzini、Lasse Heje Pedersen於2013年提出，相關論文於2019年發表，美國市場數據可追溯至1957年7月。
這項指標以獲利能力、成長性及安全性衡量企業品質。其中，獲利能力採用六項指標，成長性觀察過去五年每股盈餘變化，安全性則綜合股價波動、資產負債表穩健程度與股東權益報酬率的波動。
QMJ每月對美國上市股票評分，買進排名最高的30%企業，同時放空排名最低的30%，採市值加權並每月調整。因此，指標上漲代表優質股相對占上風，不等於整體股市上漲。
值得留意的是，QMJ完全不考慮估值，只衡量企業品質。從1957年7月至2026年8月，優質股平均每年跑贏低品質股3.6%，但短期仍可能長時間落後。
投機狂熱退燒 市場往往面臨調整
自1957年以來，QMJ曾經歷八次跌幅超過10%的下行週期。其中，由科技狂熱推動的典型案例，包括1960年代電子與電腦熱潮、1999年網路泡沫，以及2020年電動車、加密貨幣與遠距辦公熱潮。
這三次泡沫破裂後的兩年內，優質股分別跑贏低品質股28%、68%及41%；同期整體股市報酬分別為負4.5%、負23.5%與正6.4%。最後一次仍錄得正報酬，與比較基期落在疫情崩盤後低點有關。
不過，低品質股領漲並非一律意味泡沫。重大熊市過後，央行大量注入流動性，可能讓財務脆弱、瀕臨破產的企業得以存活，帶動股價從低點反彈。1970年代、1992年、2002年及2009年，都曾出現這類情況。
本輪行情的背景則不同。標普500在此期間持續創高，低品質股的強勢主要來自AI熱潮，並非熊市過後的復甦，也不是低估值帶動的反彈。
資金轉向優質股 投機股遭重擊
如今，市場風格已出現明顯變化。除了QMJ今年7月大漲14.3%，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子第三季下跌11%；先前強勢的高投機性個股也遭重創，AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US) 下跌56%，D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 下跌52%。
相較之下，高品質消費股明顯回升。自6月30日以來，寶僑(PG-US) 上漲12.9%、可口可樂(KO-US) 上漲17.3%、Church & Dwight(CHDN-US) 上漲12.4%，高露潔棕欖(CL-US) 也上漲6.2%，均優於標普500同期的2.3%。
Stansberry提醒，QMJ過去兩次最顯著的單月漲勢，分別出現在2000年11月與2008年10月，這段歷史對照值得警惕。隨著低品質股領漲行情逆轉，他認為，投資布局向高品質、獲利能力強的企業傾斜，可能是當前較穩健的選擇。
paras_en: U.S. stocks have lit a rare warning light! The "Quality Minus Junk factor" (QMJ), which measures the relative performance of high‑quality versus low‑quality stocks, jumped 14.3% in July, the biggest single‑month gain since 1957. Historically, the second‑ and third‑largest monthly gains occurred in November 2000 and October 2008, during the dot‑com bubble and the financial‑crisis bear markets, and the indicator’s new surge is raising market caution.

The warning follows the longest and most intense rally ever seen for low‑quality stocks. Porter and Company founder F. Porter Stansberry says the AI‑driven speculative frenzy is turning a corner and bluntly advises, "Now is the time for caution."
Low‑quality stocks surge, fueled by the AI hype

This rally in which low‑quality stocks outperformed high‑quality stocks ran from November 2023 through June 2026, setting records for both duration and magnitude. Over that period, a long‑short portfolio that bought the highest‑quality U.S. firms and shorted the lowest‑quality firms lost 36%, the worst performance for the QMJ since records began in 1957.

The 12‑month period ending May 2026 also marks the weakest 12‑month relative performance of high‑quality stocks in the 69‑year record. The QMJ posted losses for three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025 and was down another 3.8% in the first eight months of this year, reflecting the strength of investors chasing low‑quality stocks.

The AI boom is the main driver of this rally. Bloomberg data show that the loss‑making tech‑stock basket tracked by Goldman Sachs surged 57% in the first five months of the year, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 11% gain over the same period. More than a quarter of the constituents of the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, which is dominated by loss‑making firms, rose 22.7% in the first half, more than double the broad market’s rise.
Stansberry calls this wave a "technology‑driven junk‑stock bubble" and notes that its size is the largest on record.
What does the warning indicator look at? Profitability, growth and safety

The QMJ was introduced in 2013 by Cliff Asness of AQR Capital Management together with Andrea Frazzini and Lasse Heje Pedersen, with the related paper published in 2019. U.S. market data for the factor go back to July 1957.

The metric evaluates corporate quality on profitability, growth and safety. Profitability is measured by six indicators, growth looks at five‑year earnings‑per‑share changes, and safety combines price volatility, balance‑sheet strength and equity‑return volatility.

Each month the QMJ scores all U.S. listed stocks, buying the top‑30% and shorting the bottom‑30%, using market‑cap weighting and rebalancing monthly. Therefore, a rise in the index means high‑quality stocks are relatively stronger, not that the overall market is up.

It is worth noting that the QMJ ignores valuation entirely and only measures quality. From July 1957 through August 2026, high‑quality stocks have outperformed low‑quality stocks by an average of 3.6% per year, though short‑term periods can see prolonged underperformance.
Speculative frenzy cools, markets often face corrections

Since 1957 the QMJ has experienced eight down‑turn cycles of more than 10% decline. Typical cases driven by tech hype include the 1960s electronics and computer boom, the 1999 dot‑com bubble, and the 2020 surges in electric vehicles, cryptocurrencies and remote‑work technologies.

In the two years after each of those three bubbles burst, high‑quality stocks outperformed low‑quality stocks by 28%, 68% and 41% respectively, while total market returns were –4.5%, –23.5% and +6.4%. The last episode still posted a positive return, partly because the base period was the post‑pandemic market low.

However, a rally led by low‑quality stocks does not always signal a bubble. After major bear markets, central‑bank liquidity injections can keep financially fragile, near‑bankrupt firms alive, prompting price rebounds from lows. Similar patterns occurred in the 1970s, 1992, 2002 and 2009.

The backdrop for the current rally is different. The S&P 500 kept making new highs during this span, and the strength of low‑quality stocks stems mainly from the AI boom, not from a post‑bear‑market recovery or a value‑driven bounce.
Funds shift to quality, speculative stocks take a hit

Today market style has shifted markedly. In addition to the QMJ’s 14.3% jump in July, Goldman Sachs’ loss‑making tech basket fell 11% in the third quarter, and previously strong high‑speculation stocks have been hammered – AST SpaceMobile (ASTS‑US) down 56% and D‑Wave Quantum (QBTS‑US) down 52%.

By contrast, high‑quality consumer stocks have clearly rebounded. Since June 30, Procter & Gamble (PG‑US) is up 12.9%, Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) up 17.3%, Church & Dwight (CHDN‑US) up 12.4% and Colgate‑Palmolive (CL‑US) up 6.2%, all outperforming the S&P 500’s 2.3% gain over the same period.

Stansberry warns that the QMJ’s two most pronounced single‑month spikes occurred in November 2000 and October 2008, and that history should serve as a caution. As the low‑quality rally reverses, he suggests tilting portfolios toward high‑quality, profit‑rich companies may be the more prudent current approach.

items.title: 英特爾股價狂瀉近3成！PC疲弱、代工大單未明 明年自由現金流恐轉負
items.title_en: Intel Stock Plummets Nearly 30% as Weak PC Demand and Unclear Foundry Outlook Weigh; Free Cash Flow May Turn Negative Next Year
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 資料中心營收創15年來最強成長，卻難掩PC走弱與代工前景未明的壓力。記憶體漲價壓抑換機需求，公司預估第四季客戶端營收將季減逾20%，外部代工大單仍無明確時程。財測遜於預期，加上明年資本支出將大增、自由現金流恐轉負，拖累股價周五(30日)盤中重挫近三成。
這次市場失望的重點，不在當季獲利，而在接下來的營運展望。PC放緩至少延續至明年上半年，代工仍持續虧損，明年資本支出又將大幅增加。即使伺服器訂單強勁，仍難抵銷市場對轉型進度與現金流的疑慮。
PC先走弱 第四季營收估再減逾兩成
以PC與筆電處理器為主的客戶端業務（CCPG），第三季營收80.97億美元，年減5%、季減9%，低於公司預期；營業利益22.85億美元，營業利益率約28%。
客戶端業務仍是英特爾最大的營收來源，但公司預估第四季營收將再季減逾20%。財務長辛斯納（Dave Zinsner）表示，PC市場放緩至少持續至明年上半年，庫存調整則至少延續至第一季。
英特爾預估，2026年PC整體潛在市場以出貨量計將萎縮約12%，其中下半年降幅超過20%；2027年可能再減少約10%。
記憶體漲價是壓抑需求的重要因素。資料中心仍願意支付更高價格取得記憶體，PC市場卻因整機成本上升，削弱消費者換機意願，連帶拖累處理器銷售。
摩根士丹利估計，客戶端業務持續惡化，將使市場對英特爾營收的共識預估面臨約30億至40億美元的下修壓力。
當季獲利超預期 下季財測卻落空
英特爾第三季營收165.13億美元，年增21%，大致符合市場預期的約165億美元；經調整每股盈餘0.52美元，優於市場預估的約0.40美元，也高於公司原先預測的約0.38美元。
然而，公司預估第四季營收僅150億至160億美元，低於市場預期的約171億美元；經調整每股盈餘估為0.25美元，同樣不及市場預估的約0.43美元。
以色列南部基亞特加特Fab 28廠本月初發生爆炸、停產約兩週，也衝擊部分10奈米伺服器產品供應。辛斯納表示，初步估計事故將使第四季營收減少約3億美元，毛利率下降約2個百分點，明年第一季營收可能受到類似影響。
多數晶圓報廢損失將列入第四季。不過，相較工廠事故，PC銷售疲弱才是第四季財測低於市場預期的主要原因。
代工被寄予厚望 客戶時程仍待交代
英特爾前執行長季辛格推動IDM 2.0策略，希望自家晶圓廠除了生產內部產品，也能承接外部訂單，並投入資金建廠、追趕先進製程。
陳立武上任後，市場一度猜測他會縮減代工業務以改善財務表現，但他持續將代工列為優先發展項目。公司8月增發股票籌資約230億美元後，市場也將期待寄託於供應改善、18A製程產能提升，以及外部客戶訂單落實。
然而，第三季代工業務營收66.97億美元，絕大部分仍來自內部訂單。外部收入雖季增1.18億美元至4.11億美元，主要由一次性客戶專案帶動，該部門營業虧損仍達18.53億美元。
財報電話會議上，美銀直接追問，外部客戶何時會從評估進入正式投片，也就是完成設計並交由晶圓廠製造，以及相關收入何時能納入財務預估。
陳立武未透露客戶細節，僅表示封裝業務未來兩季可能有客戶準備宣布消息；至於18A與14A，仍未提供明確時程或可供估算的收入數字。
先進製程能否換來大單 仍待驗證
SemiAnalysis指出，英特爾18A雖已出貨，電晶體密度並未領先台積電同級製程，高階GPU與I/O晶片仍須搭配台積電產能。
摩根士丹利認為，市場對英特爾代工的信心，主要押注14A製程於2028年或2029年落實，但目前外部客戶的大量生產承諾仍有限。
該行更擔心英特爾的結構性能力不足，認為若連自家產品需求都無法滿足，將不利於爭取外部客戶。對代工轉型而言，製程推出之後，能否取得持續且具規模的訂單，仍是重要考驗。
伺服器訂單強勁 供應卻跟不上
英特爾第三季資料中心與AI業務（DCAI）營收73.18億美元，年增78%、季增17%；營業利益30.39億美元，營業利益率約42%，獲利已超越客戶端業務。
陳立武表示，儘管短期PC產業面臨逆風，CPU需求依然強勁，目前首要任務是增加供應，滿足Xeon系列的龐大需求。
但供應瓶頸不只在晶圓製造。管理層指出，Intel 3製程產出正逐步增加，業界先進有機基板短缺卻限制EMIB先進封裝產能，進而影響伺服器CPU交貨。
公司預估，2026年與2027年產業伺服器CPU出貨量每年將成長逾30%，供應吃緊可能延續至2027年底，甚至進入2028年。全年DCAI營收則可望較年初預期高出約100億美元。
摩根士丹利仍認為，這些強勁數字高度依賴供不應求的環境，英特爾旗艦產品相較同業依然偏弱。在AMD與Arm架構持續競爭下，英特爾能否擴大市占，仍取決於供應改善程度。
明年還要加碼投資 現金流恐轉負
英特爾季末現金及短期投資約540億美元，有息負債約501億美元。8月增資充實資金，但後續晶圓與封裝產線投資，以及代工業務虧損，仍將持續消耗現金。
公司維持2026年資本支出毛額約200億美元的預估，2027年則將大幅增加，確切金額尚未敲定。辛斯納直言，明年將是投資年，自由現金流很可能無法維持正值。
第三季調整後自由現金流為16億美元，但這項正向表現未必能延續至明年。摩根士丹利認為，即使後續財務預估上修，目前股價也已大致反映相關利多。
英特爾眼前的難題是，PC業務已開始拖累營運，代工收入卻仍缺乏明確時間表。伺服器需求雖強，供應限制與持續增加的投資，讓市場更難單憑尚未兌現的轉型前景買單。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) saw data‑center revenue post its strongest growth in 15 years, but that could not mask the pressure from a weakening PC market and an uncertain foundry outlook. Higher memory prices are suppressing upgrade demand, and the company forecasts client‑side revenue to fall more than 20% in Q4, with no clear timeline for large external foundry orders. The financial outlook fell short of expectations, and with capital spending set to surge next year, free cash flow could turn negative, dragging the stock down nearly 30% during Friday’s (30th) session.

The market’s disappointment this time centers not on the current quarter’s earnings but on the forward operating outlook. The PC slowdown is expected to continue at least into the first half of next year, the foundry business remains loss‑making, and capital expenditures are slated to rise sharply next year. Even strong server orders are unlikely to offset concerns about the pace of transformation and cash‑flow pressures.
PC Weakness Leads to Over 20% Revenue Decline Forecast for Q4

Client‑side business (CCPG), which focuses on PC and laptop processors, posted Q3 revenue of $8.097 billion, down 5% year‑over‑year and 9% quarter‑over‑quarter, missing company expectations; operating profit was $2.285 billion, yielding an operating margin of about 28%.

Client‑side remains Intel’s largest revenue source, yet the company projects Q4 revenue to decline another >20% quarter‑over‑quarter. CFO Dave Zinsner said the PC market slowdown will last at least through the first half of next year, with inventory adjustments extending into Q1.
Intel estimates the overall PC addressable market will shrink about 12% by volume in 2026, with the second half seeing a decline of over 20%; a further ~10% reduction is possible in 2027.

Rising memory prices are a key factor dampening demand. While data‑centers are still willing to pay higher prices for memory, the PC market faces higher system costs, reducing consumers’ willingness to upgrade and dragging down processor sales.
Morgan Stanley estimates that continued deterioration in the client‑side business could force a downward revision of consensus revenue estimates by roughly $3‑$4 billion.
Quarterly Profit Beats Estimates, but Next‑Quarter Guidance Misses

Intel reported Q3 revenue of $16.513 billion, up 21% year‑over‑year and roughly in line with market expectations of about $16.5 billion; adjusted earnings were $0.52 per share, above the market’s roughly $0.40 estimate and higher than the company’s own prior guidance of about $0.38.

However, the company projects Q4 revenue of only $15‑$16 billion, below the market’s roughly $17.1 billion expectation; adjusted earnings are forecast at $0.25 per share, also missing the market’s roughly $0.43 estimate.

An explosion at Intel’s Fab 28 plant in Kiryat Gat, Israel, early this month halted production for about two weeks and disrupted supply of some 10‑nm server products. Zinsner said the incident is preliminarily estimated to shave roughly $300 million off Q4 revenue and cut gross margin by about two percentage points, with similar effects possible in Q1 next year.
Most wafer‑scrap losses will be booked in Q4. Nonetheless, compared with the plant incident, weak PC sales are the primary reason the Q4 outlook fell short of market expectations.
Foundry Hopes Remain but Customer Timelines Remain Unclear
Former CEO Pat Gelsinger pushed the IDM 2.0 strategy, hoping Intel’s fabs would not only serve internal products but also take external orders and receive investment to catch up on advanced nodes.

After Pat Gelsinger’s successor, Pat Fritz, took over, the market briefly speculated that he might scale back the foundry business to improve financial performance, yet he continues to prioritize it. Following a $23 billion stock raise in August, investors are looking for supply improvements, 18A capacity gains, and concrete external customer orders.

Nevertheless, Q3 foundry revenue was $6.697 billion, with the vast majority still coming from internal orders. External revenue rose modestly by $118 million to $411 million, driven mainly by one‑off customer projects, while the segment posted an operating loss of $1.853 billion.

During the earnings call, Bank of America directly asked when external customers would move from evaluation to actual production—i.e., complete design and hand over to the fab—and when related revenue could be incorporated into financial guidance.

Pat Fritz did not disclose customer details, only noting that packaging business may see customers announce news in the next two quarters; regarding 18A and 14A, no clear timelines or revenue estimates were provided.
Can Advanced Nodes Secure Large Orders? Still Unproven
SemiAnalysis notes that while Intel’s 18A has shipped, its transistor density does not lead the comparable TSMC node, and high‑end GPUs and I/O chips still rely on TSMC capacity.
Morgan Stanley believes market confidence in Intel’s foundry hinges on the 14A node being in production by 2028‑2029, yet large‑scale external commitments remain limited at present.

The firm also worries about Intel’s structural capability gaps, arguing that if Intel cannot even meet its own product demand, it will struggle to win external customers. For the foundry transition, securing sustained, sizable orders after a node’s launch remains a critical test.
Strong Server Orders but Supply Lags Behind

Intel’s Q3 data‑center and AI (DCAI) revenue was $7.318 billion, up 78% year‑over‑year and 17% quarter‑over‑quarter; operating profit was $3.039 billion, yielding an operating margin of about 42%, surpassing client‑side profitability.
Pat Fritz said that despite short‑term headwinds for the PC industry, CPU demand remains robust and the top priority is to increase supply to meet the massive demand for Xeon processors.

However, supply constraints extend beyond wafer fabrication. Management noted that output from Intel 3 is gradually increasing, but a shortage of advanced organic substrates limits EMIB advanced‑packaging capacity, affecting server‑CPU deliveries.

The company forecasts that industry server‑CPU shipments will grow over 30% annually in 2026 and 2027, with tight supply potentially persisting through the end of 2027 and into 2028. Full‑year DCAI revenue could be about $10 billion higher than early‑year expectations.

Morgan Stanley still argues that these strong numbers rely heavily on a supply‑demand imbalance, and Intel’s flagship products remain relatively weak versus peers. With AMD and Arm architectures continuing to compete, Intel’s ability to gain market share will depend on how quickly supply improves.
Investments to Ramp Up Next Year; Cash Flow May Turn Negative

Intel’s quarter‑end cash and short‑term investments total roughly $54 billion, with interest‑bearing debt of about $50.1 billion. The August capital raise bolstered liquidity, but ongoing wafer and packaging line investments and foundry losses will continue to drain cash.

The company maintains a 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook of roughly $20 billion, with a substantial increase slated for 2027, though the exact amount is not yet set. CFO Zinsner bluntly said next year will be an investment year and free cash flow is likely to turn negative.

Adjusted free cash flow in Q3 was $1.6 billion, but this positive result may not carry over into next year. Morgan Stanley believes that even if later financial guidance is raised, the stock price already reflects most of the upside.

Intel’s immediate challenge is that the PC business is already dragging on operations while foundry revenue still lacks a clear timeline. Server demand is strong, but supply constraints and rising investment make it harder for the market to bet on an unproven transformation outlook.

items.title: 美限制中國檢測認證機構！北京要求撤回並警告反制
items.title_en: U.S. Restricts Chinese Testing and Certification Bodies; Beijing Demands Withdrawal and Warns of Countermeasures
paras: 美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)通過新規，將禁止位於中國等被列為「非互惠」經濟體的檢測與認證機構承接FCC相關業務。中國商務部周五(30日)要求美方立即撤回措施，並警告，若華府「一意孤行」，中方將採取必要措施維護自身權益。
FCC周四表決通過的限制，涵蓋檢測實驗室、電信認證機構及實驗室認可組織，禁止這些機構從事FCC相關檢測、認證或認可工作。新規預定於2028年12月生效。
中國商務部在聲明中指控，FCC不顧中方反對，多次推出針對中國的限制措施，違反兩國領導人達成的重要共識，已「嚴重損害」中美經貿關係穩定，並擾亂全球供應鏈。
北京表示，曾多次提議與華府就雙邊相互承認協議展開磋商，但美方回應「極不具建設性且消極」。這類協議的目的，在於讓雙方接受彼此符合約定條件的檢測或認證結果。
中國商務部也警告，新限制將提高檢測成本，拉長產品交付與更新週期，最終損害美國企業及消費者利益。中方呼籲，美國應正視產業界關切、尊重市場原則，並與中國共同尋求解決方案。
儘管發出反制警告，中國商務部仍強調，透過協商解決爭議的大門始終敞開。聲明未具體說明可能採取哪些反制措施。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has adopted new rules that will bar testing and certification bodies located in China and other economies deemed “non‑reciprocal” from undertaking FCC‑related work. China’s Ministry of Commerce on Friday (the 30th) demanded that the United States immediately rescind the measure and warned that if Washington “goes ahead alone,” China will take necessary steps to protect its own interests.

The FCC’s Thursday vote approved restrictions covering testing laboratories, telecom certification agencies and accreditation bodies, prohibiting them from performing FCC‑related testing, certification or accreditation work. The new rule is slated to take effect in December 2028.

In its statement, China’s Ministry of Commerce accused the FCC of ignoring Chinese objections and repeatedly rolling out measures targeting China, violating an important consensus reached by the two leaders, severely damaging the stability of U.S.–China economic and trade relations, and disrupting global supply chains.

Beijing said it has repeatedly proposed to the United States to negotiate a bilateral mutual‑recognition agreement, but the U.S. response has been “highly unconstructive and passive.” Such agreements aim to allow both sides to accept each other’s testing or certification results that meet agreed‑upon conditions.

The Ministry also warned that the new restrictions will raise testing costs, lengthen product delivery and update cycles, ultimately harming U.S. companies and consumers. China called on the United States to take industry concerns seriously, respect market principles, and work with China to find a solution.

Despite issuing a countermeasure warning, the Ministry of Commerce stressed that the door remains open for resolving the dispute through negotiation. The statement did not specify what retaliatory actions might be taken.

items.title: 法國政經動盪拖累歐元！兌英鎊恐寫逾四年最慘單月表現
items.title_en: France's Political and Economic Turmoil Drags the Euro; Against the Pound May Record Its Worst Monthly Performance in Over Four Years
paras: 法國政治與財政風險升高，拖累歐元兌英鎊走弱，10月跌幅已超過2%，恐創2022年7月以來最差單月表現。相較之下，英國經濟數據優於預期，加上本周預算案未掀起太大波瀾，凸顯相對穩定的局勢，支撐英鎊表現。
歐元兌英鎊周五(30日)跌至2025年4月以來最低。英鎊本月兌歐元的升幅，則居十大工業國(G10)貨幣之冠，反映投資人對英法兩國前景的評價差距擴大。
法國遲遲難以控制預算赤字，引發債市劇烈波動，推升政府借款成本至25年高點，也壓抑歐元走勢。隨著明年全國性選舉逼近，教育制度與生活成本問題引發的抗議，更增添政治不確定性。
富國銀行(WFC-US)策略師Marcus Jennings表示，法國身為歐元區第二大經濟體，政治與財政風險升高，加上英國經濟相對有韌性，可能使歐元兌英鎊跌勢延續。他預估，年底前匯價將降至接近0.83英鎊。
Jennings指出，歐元區成長動能出現減弱跡象，英國數據卻持續優於預期。國際貨幣基金(IMF)本月稍早也上調英國經濟成長預測，進一步支撐英鎊。
不過，英國自身仍面臨財政難題。許多投資人質疑政府能否落實控制支出的承諾，相關疑慮已拖累英鎊兌美元表現，而財政限制也可能壓抑未來幾年的經濟成長。
選擇權市場目前同樣顯示，歐元兌英鎊情緒轉弱，逆轉周四觸及四周高點的樂觀程度。歐洲央行當天淡化了市場對其可能介入、平息法債賣壓的預期。
荷蘭合作銀行G10外匯策略主管Jane Foley表示，法國困境讓英鎊顯得相對有吸引力，預期政治風險將持續壓抑歐元至明年。
paras_en: France's political and fiscal risks are rising, weighing down the euro against the pound, which has fallen more than 2% in October and could mark the worst monthly performance since July 2022. In contrast, UK economic data have been better than expected and this week's budget did not cause major turbulence, highlighting a relatively stable situation that supports the pound.

The euro fell to its lowest level against the pound since April 2025 on Friday (the 30th). The pound's gain against the euro this month tops the G10 industrial nation currencies, reflecting a widening investor rating gap between the UK and France.

France's difficulty in controlling its budget deficit has sparked severe bond market volatility, pushing government borrowing costs to a 25‑year high and suppressing the euro's trajectory. With a national election looming next year, protests over the education system and living‑cost issues add further political uncertainty.

Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) strategist Marcus Jennings said that France, as the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, faces heightened political and fiscal risks, while the UK economy remains relatively resilient, which could keep the euro‑pound decline going. He forecasts the exchange rate could fall to around £0.83 by year‑end.

Jennings noted that growth momentum in the euro area is showing signs of weakening, whereas UK data continue to beat expectations. The International Monetary Fund also raised its UK growth forecast earlier this month, further bolstering the pound.

However, the UK still faces its own fiscal challenges. Many investors doubt the government’s ability to stick to its spending‑control promises, a concern that has already weighed on the pound‑dollar pair, and fiscal constraints could curb economic growth in the coming years.

The options market also now shows weakening sentiment for the euro‑pound pair, reversing the optimism that had pushed it to a four‑week high on Thursday. The European Central Bank on that day downplayed expectations that it might intervene to calm French bond‑selling pressure.

Jane Foley, head of G10 FX strategy at Dutch cooperative bank ABN Amro, said France’s troubles make the pound look relatively attractive and she expects political risk to keep the euro under pressure into next year.

中原證券認為，當前滬指與創業板指數的平均本益比分別為16.14倍、37.37倍，處於近三年中位數平均上方，適合中長期佈局。中國國家統計局數據顯示，今年前三季GDP年增4.6%，高技術製造業占規模以上工業增加值的比重同比提升1.6個百分點，新動能對經濟成長貢獻率保持在40%以上，滬指繼續震盪整理的機率較大，結構再平衡為核心特徵，宜密切關注宏觀經濟數據、海外流動性變化以及政策動向，短線建議關注航天裝備、軍工電子、風電設備及銀行等產業的投資機會。

萬聯證券亦稱，從經濟數據看，國民經濟運行平穩，宏觀調控維持適度寬鬆的基調。資本市場方面，10月A股流動性指標表現分化，市場投資者情緒與風險偏好受多因素影響，市場改善仍需更多支持。隨著相關部門持續深化資本市場投融資綜合改革，擴大耐心資本、長期資本和戰略資本供給，預計市場韌性有望增強，流動性環境有望改善。多重利多政策提振下，市場信心有望修復。從業績看，今年第三季財報披露接近尾聲，結構性亮點湧現。一方面，新質生產力領域，在技術創新與產業鏈協同帶動下保持高景氣增長。另一方面，具備技術、成本與供應鏈優勢的出海龍頭企業展現出較強的盈利韌性。
paras_en: China's three main A‑share indices all closed lower on Friday (Oct 30). The Shanghai Composite (SSEC) posted a second straight daily loss, slipping below the 3,600‑point threshold, down 2.48% for the week and marking a sixth consecutive weekly decline; the monthly chart is down more than 6%. Both the ChiNext Index and the STAR‑50 index are down over 23% on the month. The Shenzhen Component (SZI) also logged its sixth weekly loss, falling 7.2% for the week and ending the month down 15.94%.

The Shanghai index fell 1.44% on Friday to 3,599.02 points, while the Shenzhen index dropped 2.73% to 10,833.78 points. The ChiNext index closed down 4.13% at 2,413.63 points and the STAR‑50 index plunged 5.48%. Total market turnover reached 1.6744 trillion yuan, an increase of 117.9 billion yuan from the previous day.

On the market front, the optical‑communication sector led the declines, with companies such as Coretronic, Canqian Technology, Huichang Technology, Dekoli and Quectel hitting limit‑down or falling more than 10%. Tai­chen Guang, Xin‑Yisheng and Shenghong Technology each fell over 13%. Film‑theatre stocks also suffered heavy losses, with Wenti Holding, Hengdian Film, Ciwen Media, Aofei Entertainment and Jicheng Shares touching limit‑down. Software, semiconductor and defense‑industry groups were among the worst‑performing, with more than 20 stocks—including Tongda Sea, Compass, Daotong Technology, Fortune Trend, BGI Genomics and 3D World—either limit‑down or down over 10%.

Among the gainers, the liquor sector surged throughout the session, with Black Sesame, Luzhou Laojiao, New Dairy, Huangtai Liquor, Gujing Gong Jiu, Yingjia Gong Jiu, Qingdao Food and Haoxiangni all hitting limit‑up. Port and shipping stocks also saw a wave of limit‑ups, led by Jinjiang Shipping and COSCO Shipping. The banking sector continued its rally, with Xi’an Bank soaring 8.64%, Qingnan Bank jumping 5.57%, and Suzhou Bank, Changsha Bank and others gaining more than 2%.

According to Wind data, a total of 893 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges, while 4,598 fell and 82 were unchanged. Data from Dazhihui VIP shows that across the three markets, 61 stocks gained more than 9% and 266 stocks lost more than 9%.

Donghai Securities noted that the Shanghai index reclaimed its 5‑day moving average only to lose it again, with volume easing and large‑order capital flowing out rather than in—net outflows exceeded 25.6 billion yuan. The daily KDJ has not yet formed a death cross and the daily MACD has not produced a golden cross, leaving the daily indicators contradictory. The index is again approaching support at the 555‑day moving average and is close to the 120‑week average of 3,618 points. Technical conditions on the daily chart are not yet clearly improving; minute‑level indicators are weakening again. The index faces pressure from the 5‑week and 10‑week averages above and support from the 120‑week average below, suggesting a possible short‑term range‑bound pattern.

Zhongyuan Securities believes the current average price‑to‑earnings ratios for the Shanghai Composite and the ChiNext are 16.14 × and 37.37 × respectively, both above the three‑year median, making them suitable for medium‑ to long‑term positioning. National Bureau of Statistics data shows GDP grew 4.6% year‑on‑year in the first three quarters, with high‑tech manufacturing’s share of industrial added value above scale rising 1.6 percentage points. New‑energy drivers contribute over 40% to growth. The Shanghai index is likely to continue oscillating, with structural rebalancing as a core feature. Investors should monitor macro data, overseas liquidity and policy trends, and in the short term focus on aerospace equipment, defense electronics, wind‑power equipment and banks for investment opportunities.

Wanlian Securities also said that economic data indicate a stable national economy and that macro‑policy remains moderately accommodative. In the capital market, October’s A‑share liquidity indicators were mixed, and investor sentiment and risk appetite were affected by multiple factors, so market improvement still needs more support. As regulators deepen comprehensive reforms of capital market financing, expanding patient, long‑term and strategic capital supply, market resilience is expected to strengthen and liquidity conditions improve. With multiple bullish policies, confidence should recover. From a performance perspective, third‑quarter earnings are nearing completion, revealing structural highlights: on one hand, new‑quality productivity sectors are maintaining high growth driven by technological innovation and supply‑chain coordination; on the other, overseas‑focused leading firms with technology, cost and supply‑chain advantages are showing strong earnings resilience.

items.title: 強通膨+鷹派央行+AI資金撐腰！美元將創近一年半最佳月度表現　分析師：美大選難改強勢邏輯
items.title_en: Strong Inflation, Hawkish Central Banks, and AI Funding Back the Dollar—Projected Best Monthly Performance in a Year and a Half, Analysts Say U.S. Election Won’t Reverse the Trend
paras: 美元正走出一輪強勢行情，美元指數10月攀升至2025年5月以來高位，今年來累計上漲約3.45%，主要因為強於預期的通膨、Fed可能重啟升息的預期，以及AI投資帶來的資本流入，華爾街多家機構已陸續撤回看空判斷，CFTC數據也顯示資管機構與非商業交易者押注美元升值的部位規模近400億美元，自3月中以來始終維持多頭立場。
利率預期是核心支柱。Fed週三(28日)維持利率不變，但主席華許釋放明確鷹派訊號，並稱官員已做好「採取行動的準備」。 Fed上月做出三年來首次升息決定，帶動美元創3月以來最佳單月表現，市場定價繼續為匯價托底。
宏利投資投資組合經理Nathan Thooft指出，不應過度放大美國期中選舉對美元長期走勢的影響。 「外匯市場更多由相對經濟成長、通膨、利率和資本流動所驅動。」
他並認為，若選舉形成分裂政府，政策不確定性反而可能下降，為美元提供穩定性。
AI資金是另一個關鍵支撐。美銀策略師Alex Cohen表示，即便民主黨在11月3日選舉中拿下國會至少一院，川普仍可用否決權擋住AI監管立法，意味著推動美元走強的「AI交易」未必熄火。
Cohen也明確指出，若選舉後美元因AI敘事降溫而遭拋售，將反向加碼。
根據花旗策略師Daniel Tobon統計，歷屆美國期中大選過後，美元往往偏弱，但本輪即使回落，持續時間可能很短，因通膨韌性與Fed緊縮會抵消政治擾動。
摩根士丹利也已推翻「2026年美元持續走弱」的預測，該行G10外匯主管Steven Englander強調，只要市場相信Fed繼續壓低通膨、維持較高實際利率，美元就有上行空間。
不過，下檔風險正在累積。Man Group首席市場策略師Kristina Hooper提醒，AI資本開支若明顯放緩，將削弱美國成長預期與國際資金流入動力。
地緣局勢同樣攸關美元走勢，美伊戰爭擾動能源供應，油價今年來上漲約80%，利多美元、壓制歐元與日元，加上法國財政惡化也加重歐元貶值壓力。
加拿大帝國商業銀行(CIBC)資本市場策略師Noah Buffam則指出，最該盯的變數是川普選後如何處理伊朗，若克制用兵，美元可能與油價一同回落。
綜合來看，美國11月3日選舉結果未必直接決定美元方向。短期由通膨與Fed鷹派定調，中期看AI投資能否延續，長期則繫於中東局勢，強美元邏輯，暫時未到反轉時。
paras_en: The dollar is emerging from a strong rally, with the U.S. Dollar Index climbing to its highest level since May 2025 in October and having risen about 3.45% year‑to‑date, driven by stronger‑than‑expected inflation, expectations that the Fed may restart rate hikes, and capital inflows from AI investment. Several Wall Street firms have already withdrawn bearish views, and CFTC data shows that asset‑management firms and non‑commercial traders have bet on dollar appreciation with positions close to $40 billion, maintaining a long stance since mid‑March.

Rate expectations are the core pillar. The Fed left rates unchanged on Wednesday (28th), but Chairman Jerome Powell sent a clear hawkish signal and said officials were ready to "take action." Last month, the Fed made its first rate hike in three years, sparking the dollar’s best single‑month performance since March, and markets continue to price in support for the currency.

Macro‑investment portfolio manager Nathan Thooft of Macro Investments said the U.S. midterm election should not be overstated in its long‑term impact on the dollar. "The forex market is driven more by relative economic growth, inflation, rates, and capital flows," he said.
He also believes that if the election results in a divided government, policy uncertainty could actually decrease, providing stability for the dollar.

AI funding is another key support. Bank of America strategist Alex Cohen noted that even if the Democrats win at least one house in the November 3 election, Trump could still use his veto power to block AI regulatory legislation, meaning the "AI trading" that fuels dollar strength may not die down.
Cohen also made it clear that if the dollar is sold off due to a cooling AI narrative after the election, it will be bought back in reverse.

According to Citigroup strategist Daniel Tobon, historically the dollar tends to weaken after U.S. midterm elections, but this time even if it falls, the duration may be short because inflation resilience and Fed tightening will offset political turbulence.

Morgan Stanley has also overturned its forecast of a continued dollar weakness through 2026. G10 FX head Steven Englander emphasized that as long as markets believe the Fed will keep inflation low and maintain higher real rates, the dollar has upside potential.

However, downside risk is accumulating. Man Group chief market strategist Kristina Hooper warned that a significant slowdown in AI capital spending would weaken U.S. growth expectations and the momentum of international capital inflows.

Geopolitical developments also affect the dollar. U.S.–Iran tensions disrupt energy supplies, and oil prices have risen about 80% this year, which is a tailwind for the dollar and a headwind for the euro and yen. France’s deteriorating fiscal situation also adds pressure on the euro.

CIBC capital markets strategist Noah Buffam pointed out that the most important variable to watch is how Trump will handle Iran after the election. If he restrains military action, the dollar could fall alongside oil prices.

Overall, the November 3 election outcome may not directly determine the dollar’s direction. In the short term, inflation and a hawkish Fed set the tone; in the medium term, it depends on whether AI investment continues; in the long term, it hinges on Middle East dynamics. The logic of a strong dollar remains, and a reversal has not yet arrived.

items.title: 3000艘商船通過+15億桶石油出口！美軍荷姆茲海峽護航有成  但代價是每月狂燒30億美元
items.title_en: 3000 Ships Pass, Over 1.5 Billion Barrels of Oil Exported! US Navy’s Hormuz Escort Succeeds, but at a Cost of Up to $30 Billion a Month
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國在荷姆茲海峽的全天候護航與封鎖行動的成本日益升高，5萬美軍在中東部署，加上20艘艦艇，雙航空母艦與兩棲攻擊艦的，每月耗費資金20億到30億美元。儘管行動有效恢復了石油運輸，但這套防護體系的代價正急劇上升，艦員與裝備承受極限壓力。
美軍「喬治·華盛頓」號航艦戰機每夜升空，前往荷姆茲海峽攔截伊朗飛彈與無人機，幾乎每日進行護航行動。在F-35C與F/A-18戰機構築的防護網下，美軍中央司令部表示，過去六個月已協助超過3000艘商船通過海峽，累計出口石油達15億桶，波斯灣石油出口近期重新超過戰前水平。
美軍表示，約95%的航運交通能安全通過，但伊朗持續發動挑戰，10月成為開戰以來商船遇襲最頻繁月份，相關事件超過35起，主要依賴無人機與被稱為「會飛的校車」的大型亞音速巡弋飛彈。
美軍航艦連續數月全天候運作，幾乎沒有休整，部署天數創下現代紀錄。隨行的飛彈驅逐艦任務同樣繁重。
美國海軍作戰部長Daryl Caudle表示，海軍已在印度洋迪戈加西亞島建立維修中心，並增加艦員靠港休整機會。他強調，水兵能接受長期部署，但需要明確期限與休息。在航艦甲板下，地勤與維修人員壓力巨大，飛機故障率隨飛行次數激增。
政治層面，美伊局勢持續緊繃。白宮稱不會在期中大選前攻擊伊朗，但總統川普正考慮新一輪軍事打擊選項。部分官員擔憂，若無更多國際力量參與，當前封鎖難以長期維持。
對於前線飛行員來說，荷姆茲海峽最窄處僅約20英里，空域擁擠，反應時間往往只有數秒。儘管美軍稱保護任務成功率達100%，但伊朗有時會同時攻擊多艘船隻，超出防護範圍。美軍航艦指揮官Jeffrey L. Heames少將表示，儘管部署無明確終點，艦員士氣仍高。
分析人士認為，時間站在美國一邊。布魯金斯學會研究主任Michael O’Hanlon指出，川普應給予海上封鎖更多時間，逐步削弱伊朗，並明確表態做好無限期維持封鎖的準備。這場圍繞荷姆茲海峽的博弈，正考驗美軍的戰略定力。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say the United States’ round‑the‑clock escort and blockade operation in the Strait of Hormuz is becoming ever more expensive, with 50,000 troops deployed in the Middle East and 20 warships—including two aircraft carriers and amphibious assault ships—costing $2‑3 billion each month. Although the operation has effectively restored oil shipments, the price of the protection system is soaring, pushing crews and equipment to their limits.

U.S. carrier‑based aircraft from the USS George Washington launch nightly to intercept Iranian missiles and drones over the Strait of Hormuz, conducting escort missions almost every day. Under a protective umbrella of F‑35C and F/A‑18 fighters, U.S. Central Command says that in the past six months more than 3,000 merchant vessels have transited the strait, carrying a cumulative 1.5 billion barrels of oil, and Gulf oil exports have recently risen above pre‑war levels again.

The U.S. military says about 95 % of shipping traffic can pass safely, but Iran continues to launch challenges; October was the month with the most merchant‑ship attacks since the war began, with over 35 incidents, mainly using drones and a large subsonic cruise missile dubbed the “flying school bus.”

Carrier decks have been operating around the clock for consecutive months with virtually no downtime, setting a modern record for deployment length. The accompanying missile‑destroyer escorts are equally hard‑pressed.

U.S. Navy Chief of Naval Operations Daryl Caudle said the Navy has opened a maintenance hub on Diego Garcia in the Indian Ocean and is increasing opportunities for sailors to rest in port. He stressed that sailors can endure long deployments but need clear time limits and rest periods. On carrier decks, ground crews and maintenance staff are under huge pressure, and aircraft failure rates climb sharply with each flight sortie.

Politically, U.S.–Iran tensions remain high. The White House says it will not strike Iran before the mid‑term elections, but President Trump is reportedly weighing a new round of military options. Some officials warn that without greater international participation the current blockade cannot be sustained indefinitely.

For frontline pilots, the narrowest point of the Strait of Hormuz is only about 20 miles wide, making the airspace extremely congested with reaction times often measured in seconds. Although the U.S. claims a 100 % success rate for its protection missions, Iran sometimes attacks multiple vessels simultaneously, overwhelming the defensive envelope. Carrier commander Rear Admiral Jeffrey L. Heames said morale remains high even though there is no defined end‑point for the deployment.

Analysts say time is on America’s side. Michael O’Hanlon, director of research at the Brookings Institution, argues that Trump should give the maritime blockade more time, gradually weakening Iran while clearly stating the U.S. is prepared to maintain the blockade indefinitely. This Hormuz showdown is testing the strategic resolve of the U.S. military.

items.title: 日銀利率暫留1.25% 分析師估12月升至1.5% 終點上看2%
items.title_en: BOJ Keeps Rate at 1.25% – Analysts See 1.5% Rise in December, Target Around 2%
paras: 日本銀行 (日銀) 預計在周五 (30日) 結束的貨幣政策會議上維持基準利率於1.25%不變，但可能在最新季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的通膨預測，並強調日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。這將顯示日銀政策重心正從長期刺激通膨，轉向防止物價漲幅超標，為最快12月再次升息保留空間。
《路透社》報導指出，日銀此次預計不會連續兩次會議升息，而是希望進一步觀察先前升息對銀行放款條件與金融環境的影響。不過，日銀可能藉由政策聲明釋出更明確的訊號，表明未來將持續調升利率，逐步使利率接近不刺激、也不抑制經濟活動的中性水準。

這項政策轉向將延續日銀上月傳達的訊息。分析人士指出，日銀已進入較為重視抑制通膨風險的政策階段，未來可能每隔數個月升息一次。瑞穗研究所 (Mizuho Research Institute) 執行經濟學家、日銀前高層門間一夫表示，人工智慧 (AI) 投資帶來的全球價格壓力相當強勁，近期通膨有一部分是由需求增加所推動。他認為，日銀若確認政策方向已經轉變，等於向市場傳達可能每季升息的訊號，並預測日銀可能在12月及明年3月升息。
日銀總裁植田和男會後記者會的談話，也將成為市場觀察未來升息時點與幅度的重要依據。熟悉日銀想法的人士向《路透社》透露，日銀可能在季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的物價預測，並指出日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。隨著薪資成長逐漸穩定，企業與家庭的通膨預期也維持在約2%，日銀可能強調，接下來的政策任務是透過逐步升息，讓通膨穩定在目標附近。
日本通膨壓力仍是日銀考慮進一步緊縮政策的主要原因。9月核心消費者物價通膨率在睽違9個月後再次超過日銀2%的目標，中東衝突延長推升燃料成本，也削弱政府燃料補貼對物價的抑制效果。日銀7月公布的季度預測原本就預期，隨著企業持續將成本上升轉嫁給消費者，未來數月通膨可能加速。
日元走弱同樣加劇物價壓力。日元貶值推高進口商品成本，能源價格居高不下則進一步增加企業與家庭負擔。日銀今年6月升息後，9月再度調高利率，兩次升息間隔已短於2024年與2025年大約每年升息兩次的節奏，顯示政策正常化速度正在加快。
根據《路透社》對分析師的調查，多數受訪者預期日銀最快在12月將政策利率由1.25%提高至1.5%，之後明年仍會繼續升息。分析師對本輪升息周期終點利率的預估，主要落在1.75%至2%之間。若日銀明確表示基礎通膨已達到與2%目標一致的水準，市場可能將此解讀為央行不願容忍通膨進一步超標，未來升息步伐也可能更加靈活。
不過，日銀仍須在控制物價與維持經濟穩定之間取得平衡。若過早或過快升息，可能對企業融資、銀行放款及整體經濟活動造成影響；若通膨壓力持續擴大，則可能迫使央行加快緊縮步伐。因此，即使此次會議預計按兵不動，市場仍將密切觀察日銀是否調整通膨預測，以及植田和男對未來政策路徑的說明。
日銀政策轉向也與全球通膨環境相互呼應。AI產業投資熱潮推升部分商品與服務需求，中東衝突則造成能源供應與價格風險，美國與歐洲央行同樣面臨通膨壓力升高的挑戰。對日本而言，能源成本上升、日元偏弱與薪資成長逐步擴散，正共同影響物價走勢。
整體而言，日銀此次會議的關鍵不只在於是否維持1.25%的利率，更在於能否清楚傳達下一階段的政策方向。若日銀確認基礎通膨已接近目標，並上修未來物價預測，將進一步強化市場對12月升息的預期；但實際升息時間與後續幅度，仍取決於通膨、薪資、匯率及金融環境的變化。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1.25% at the monetary‑policy meeting ending on Friday (the 30th), but may slightly raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the latest quarterly outlook and stress that core inflation has basically reached the 2% target. This would show the BOJ’s focus shifting from long‑term stimulus to preventing price gains from overshooting, leaving room for a possible rate hike as early as December.

Reuters reported that the BOJ does not plan to raise rates at two consecutive meetings, preferring to watch how the previous hike affects banks’ lending conditions and the broader financial environment. However, the central bank may use its policy statement to send a clearer signal that it will keep tightening, gradually moving rates toward a neutral level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic activity.

This policy shift continues the message the BOJ delivered last month. Analysts say the bank has entered a phase that places greater emphasis on curbing inflation risks and may raise rates every few months. Mizuho Research Institute senior economist and former BOJ official Kazuo Kadokawa noted that AI‑driven investment is creating strong global price pressure and that recent inflation is partly demand‑driven. He believes that once the BOJ confirms the policy turn, it will signal to the market a possible quarterly hike and forecasts rate increases in December and March next year.

Comments by BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting will be a key reference for the market on the timing and magnitude of future hikes. Sources familiar with the BOJ told Reuters that the bank may modestly lift its price outlook for the next fiscal year in the quarterly outlook and point out that core inflation has essentially hit the 2% goal. With wage growth stabilising, firms and households expect inflation around 2%, and the BOJ may stress that its next task is to bring inflation close to target through gradual rate hikes.

Inflation pressure in Japan remains the main reason the BOJ is considering further tightening. Core CPI in September again exceeded the 2% target for the first time in nine months, while the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed fuel costs higher and weakened the effect of government fuel subsidies. The BOJ’s July quarterly forecast already anticipated that, as firms keep passing higher costs onto consumers, inflation could accelerate in the coming months.

A weaker yen also amplifies price pressure. Yen depreciation raises the cost of imported goods, and persistently high energy prices further increase the burden on firms and households. After the BOJ’s June hike, it raised rates again in September, with the interval between hikes now shorter than the roughly semi‑annual rhythm expected for 2024‑25, indicating an accelerating pace of policy normalisation.

A Reuters poll of analysts found most expect the BOJ to lift the policy rate from 1.25% to 1.5% as early as December, with further hikes likely next year. Analysts’ forecasts for the end‑point of this tightening cycle cluster around 1.75%‑2%. If the BOJ explicitly states that core inflation has reached the 2% target, markets may read that as a sign the central bank will not tolerate further overshoot, making future hikes potentially more flexible.

Nevertheless, the BOJ must balance price control with economic stability. Raising rates too early or too quickly could hurt corporate financing, bank lending and overall activity, while persistent inflation pressure could force a faster tightening. Hence, even if the meeting ends with a hold, markets will watch closely for any revision to inflation forecasts and Governor Ueda’s guidance on the policy path ahead.

The BOJ’s policy turn also mirrors the global inflation environment. AI‑driven investment is boosting demand for certain goods and services, the Middle‑East conflict is creating energy‑supply and price risks, and central banks in the US and Europe face similar inflation‑driving challenges. For Japan, rising energy costs, a soft yen and gradually expanding wages are jointly shaping price dynamics.

Overall, the key to this BOJ meeting is not only whether the 1.25% rate is maintained but also whether the bank can clearly convey its next‑stage policy direction. If the BOJ confirms core inflation is near target and upgrades its price outlook, it will reinforce market expectations of a December hike; however, the actual timing and size of any future moves will still depend on developments in inflation, wages, exchange rates and the financial environment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走貶 Fed、ECB維持利率不變
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Weakens as Fed and ECB Hold Rates Steady
paras: 美元周四(29日)小幅走貶，外匯市場參與者消化聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)的利率決策，歐元則微幅上漲。兩家央行均一如市場普遍預期，決定維持利率不變。另一方面，英國公布由Andy Burnham領導下的首份預算案後，英鎊連續第二個交易日延續漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.02。
聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）週三以10票對2票決定維持主要政策利率不變。聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克克(Beth Hammack)則主張升息1碼。這項結果大致符合市場預期，聯準會先前已於9月進行三年多來首次升息。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策公布後表示，近期經濟展現強勁動能，央行也持續致力於實現2%的年度通膨目標，但他拒絕對未來利率走向提供任何前瞻指引。市場目前普遍預期，聯準會將在12月今年最後一次會議上升息。
華許表示，「自我們9月採取政策行動以來，金融與信貸環境已開始出現一些變化。正如我們預期，部分企業與家庭面臨的金融與信貸條件已經收緊。市場參與者在資本配置方面也變得更加審慎。」
他接著表示，「儘管整體金融環境已經收緊，但我不願、也無法將其稱為緊縮。不過，整體而言，這些發展有助於實現更長久、更持續的經濟成長與物價穩定。」
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams指出，華許這段談話的後半部分，是記者會上最關鍵的一段發言。
Adams表示，「這段話有三個含意。第一，聯準會認為有理由進一步升息，因為『朝著這個方向前進』意味著目標尚未達成。第二，聯準會希望透過適度升息進行經濟週期中段的調整，而不是將利率推升至足以引發嚴重經濟放緩的緊縮水準。第三，即使華許希望自己能放棄前瞻指引，聯準會仍在運用這項政策工具。」
華許也指出，直到12月會議前，還有大量經濟數據將陸續公布，聯準會可以先評估這些數據，再決定是否進一步調整政策。
這波數據發布潮週四正式展開，投資人迎來美國第三季國內生產毛額（GDP）與9月重要通膨數據。
美國經濟分析局的初步估計顯示，美國第三季實質GDP成長3.4%，高於第二季的2.2%，也超越經濟學家預期的3.2%。
另一方面，被廣泛視為聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數——9月整體月增0.5%，核心PCE則月增0.3%。
以年增率計算，整體PCE上升3.6%，核心PCE則微升至3.1%。四項數據均符合市場預期，但年增率數據顯示通膨較8月加速，且明顯高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
ECB維持利率不變 歐元微幅上漲
歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1162美元。
歐洲央行稍早宣布維持三項主要政策利率不變，與聯準會的決策一致。這項決定廣受市場預期。與聯準會相同，市場目前也預期歐洲央行將在12月升息。
央行在聲明中指出，能源價格「持續上漲，對通膨前景構成上行風險，並對經濟成長前景構成下行風險」。
歐洲央行官員也表示，能源衝擊的全部影響仍在逐步顯現，而基礎物價漲幅「迄今大致保持穩定」。此外，官員指出，自上次會議以來，融資環境已經收緊。
央行另宣布，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)將於明年卸任，提前結束原定為期8年的任期。她目前領導這家央行的時間已略超過7年。
德意志銀行經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「預測歐洲央行的貨幣政策走向正變得更加困難。一個問題是，先前已經實施的兩次升息，加上9月以來金融環境的收緊，是否足以抑制能源通膨風險進一步升高？答案可能是否定的。」
他接著表示，「另一個問題是，歐洲央行領導層的變動是否會影響明年的決策？我們認為，這個機構的重要性高於個別領導者，但其中仍存在不確定性。我們預期央行將在12月再升息一次，將利率提高至2.75%，屆時拉加德仍將擔任總裁，而這可能就是本輪升息週期的終點。」
英國預算案獲市場青睞 英鎊延續漲勢
英鎊兌美元上漲0.3%，至1.3361美元，連續第二個交易日走高。
英國財政大臣John Healey週三公布預算案，維持財政規則，並避免出現沒有資金來源支撐的額外借款衝擊。預算案也確認，英國財政部在2029／30財政年度保留150億英鎊（約200.5億美元）的財政空間，符合主要交易商的預期。
德銀首席英國經濟學家Sanjay Raja週三表示，「財政大臣在秋季預算案公布前的核心原則是『不要造成傷害』，我們認為他成功達成了這個目標。最大幅度的支出增加來自表外投資。此外，降低生活成本與企業營運成本的措施，也占據了預算案相當重要的部分。」
他補充，「目前，財政大臣為自己爭取到了更多時間，但英國的財政處境正變得愈來愈微妙，更艱難的抉擇仍在後頭。」

paras_en: The dollar slipped slightly on Thursday (the 29th) as forex market participants digested the Federal Reserve’s and European Central Bank’s rate decisions, while the euro edged up modestly. Both central banks, as widely expected, left rates unchanged. Meanwhile, after the UK unveiled its first budget under Andy Burnham, the pound continued its rally for a second consecutive trading day.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.2% to 102.02.

The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10‑2 on Wednesday to keep the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The outcome was broadly in line with market expectations, following the Fed’s first rate increase in over three years back in September.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the decision that the economy has shown strong momentum recently and the central bank remains committed to achieving its 2% annual inflation goal, but he declined to provide any forward guidance on future rate moves. Markets currently expect the Fed to raise rates at its final meeting in December.

Warsh added, “Since we took policy action in September, the financial and credit environment has begun to show some changes. As we anticipated, financial and credit conditions for some businesses and households have tightened. Market participants have also become more cautious in capital allocation.”

He continued, “Although the overall financial environment has tightened, I am reluctant to label it as ‘tightening.’ Nonetheless, overall these developments help pave the way for more durable, sustained economic growth and price stability.”
Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, noted that the latter part of Warsh’s remarks was the most critical segment of the press conference.

Adams explained, “That statement carries three implications. First, the Fed sees reason to hike further because ‘moving in that direction’ signals the target has not yet been met. Second, the Fed wants to make a moderate mid‑cycle adjustment rather than push rates to a level that would trigger a severe economic slowdown. Third, even though Warsh says he would like to abandon forward guidance, the Fed is still using that tool.”
Warsh also pointed out that a large amount of economic data will be released before the December meeting, allowing the Fed to assess the numbers before deciding on any further policy adjustments.
The data‑release wave kicked off on Thursday, with investors awaiting U.S. third‑quarter GDP and key September inflation figures.
Preliminary estimates from the Bureau of Economic Analysis show real GDP grew 3.4% in Q3, up from 2.2% in Q2 and ahead of economists’ 3.2% forecast.
Meanwhile, the inflation gauge most favored by the Fed – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, with core PCE up 0.3%.

On an annual basis, overall PCE increased 3.6% and core PCE edged up to 3.1%. All four numbers matched market expectations, but the annual rates show inflation picking up from August and remaining well above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target.
ECB Holds Rates Steady, Euro Edges Higher
The euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1162.

The European Central Bank earlier announced it would keep its three main policy rates unchanged, mirroring the Fed’s decision. The move was widely anticipated. Like the Fed, markets now expect the ECB to raise rates in December.
In its statement, the ECB noted that energy prices “continue to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.”

ECB officials added that the full impact of the energy shock is still unfolding, while underlying price growth “has so far remained broadly stable.” They also said financing conditions have tightened since the last meeting.
The bank also announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down next year, ending her originally eight‑year term early. She has been at the helm for just over seven years.

Deutsche Bank economist Mark Wall said, “Predicting the ECB’s policy path is becoming increasingly difficult. One question is whether the two prior hikes, combined with the tightening financial environment since September, are enough to curb the risk of rising energy‑driven inflation. The answer may well be no.”

He continued, “Another question is whether the change in ECB leadership will affect next year’s decisions. We believe the institution’s importance outweighs any individual leader, but uncertainty remains. We expect another rate hike in December, taking the rate to 2.75%, with Lagarde still in charge, which could mark the end of this tightening cycle.”
UK Budget Wins Market Favor, Pound Continues Rise
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.3361, marking a second straight trading‑day gain.

UK Chancellor John Healey unveiled the budget on Wednesday, maintaining fiscal rules and avoiding additional borrowing without a funding source. The plan also confirmed that the Treasury will retain £15 billion (about $20.05 billion) of fiscal space for FY 2029/30, in line with major dealer expectations.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said on Wednesday, “The core principle of the autumn budget was ‘do no harm,’ and we think the chancellor achieved that. The biggest spending increase comes from off‑balance‑sheet investment. Measures to lower living costs and business operating costs also feature prominently in the budget.”
He added, “The chancellor has bought himself more time, but the UK’s fiscal situation is becoming increasingly delicate, and tougher choices lie ahead.”
